meta.name: Perfect Match
meta.description:
Couples who prove their compatibility gain the power to make or break other matches in this strategic and seductive dating competition.

Rated TV-MA · Returning Series · First aired 14 Feb 2023 · United States of America · Language: English · 65 min
Studio: Kinetic Content · Network: Netflix

Not complete. On your server: S1 12/12 | S2 10/10 | S3 not on server | S4 not on server

On your server — Audio: English

videos.title: Love is the End
videos.overview: Ten single stars from popular Netflix reality series gather at a villa to find their first matches. Two friends opt to prioritize strategy over romance.

videos.title: It's About the Chase
videos.overview: A confident new contestant threatens a budding romance. During an unusual kissing challenge, the couples swap spit and surprise themselves.

videos.title: Strike a Match
videos.overview: The last challenge's winning couple picks new dates that make waves, and tension boils over between two women with eyes on the same guy.

videos.title: Unfinished Business
videos.overview: Four people agree to a surprising partner swap, but will it cause heartache? An auction challenge has the couples betting on their chemistry.

videos.title: Blind-Sided
videos.overview: After an eye-opening round of new dates, one seemingly solid pair falls apart while another decides to re-match for a second try.

videos.title: Love is Savage
videos.overview: First-date sparks fly during a spa treatment and fizzle at a wine tasting. The couples compete to squeeze out a win in a sopping wet sponge race.

videos.title: Circling Back
videos.overview: A contestant's recent ex causes trouble in paradise. Two women start to have doubts about how compatible their matches really are.

videos.title: Mixes and Matches
videos.overview: In a first for the house, a potential same-sex couple hits it off at their first meeting. Someone who's been unlucky in love considers a big risk.

videos.title: Love It or Leave It
videos.overview: Chaos reigns in the villa as exes get jealous, a late-night make-out session causes conflict and old crushes make new comebacks.

videos.title: Making Waves
videos.overview: The couples learn a lot about each other during the final compatibility challenge and frank conversations at the house. One contestant faces doubts.

videos.title: Back in the Mix
videos.overview: After a dramatic night, the house gets ready to welcome back familiar faces for a party that will test how strong their bonds really are.

videos.title: Game, Set, Perfect Match
videos.overview: Last dates lead to emotional conversations and a huge surprise before the ultimate decision: who makes the most perfect match of all?

videos.title: Ready, Set, Match
videos.overview: Ten singles arrive in Tulum and break the ice with some dicey dares. Fledging flirtationships hang in the balance during a physical challenge.

videos.title: Kiss and Tell
videos.overview: The couples dive in lips first for the kissing challenge. A surprise date creates drama for one pair, and two sets of matches decide to shake things up.

videos.title: Chaos Theory
videos.overview: The boardroom becomes the war room when one couple stirs the pot. One contestant's reputation returns to haunt their current match — and their new date.

videos.title: Truth Bombs
videos.overview: A new match is sealed with a kiss, and the contestants are tested on how well they know one another. One couple's sweet evening turns sour.

videos.title: Shakeups & Breakups
videos.overview: A tough night turns into a testy morning in the boardroom. Matches and the matchless make bold moves as one single's sudden interest raises doubts.

videos.title: Seeing Eye to Eye
videos.overview: The couples hit the beach to test their teamwork skills. One contestant turns their attention toward a former crush. A new arrival makes a splash.

videos.title: Love Is Blindfolded
videos.overview: Trust and vulnerability are key as the couples try to untangle themselves during a compatibility challenge. One boardroom decision ushers in a storm.

videos.title: He Said, She Said
videos.overview: There's trouble in Tulum when the guys and gals enjoy their respective days out — only to be interrupted by some flirtatious party crashers.

videos.title: To Tell the Truth
videos.overview: Ahead of the final vote, couples find their futures hanging in the balance when a tense mixer brings romance and drama — plus potential new matches.

videos.title: Perfectly Ever After
videos.overview: Hot dates lead to hard conversations as the couples face their futures. But among unlikely pairs and fiery flings, who will be crowned the perfect match?

meta.slogan: In this game of love, they'll play by their own rules.
